name: Blood Banquet raises Valanar's Vengeance and Taldaram's Torment damage (#981)
contract: Blood Banquet's two ranks (560250 rank 1, 561347 rank 2) carry ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108) on two effects: MiscValue 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT) and MiscValue 0 (SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), classmask (262144,0,2097152) on both effects and both ranks. Word0 bit (262144) matches exactly the 7 Valanar's Vengeance ranks; word2 bit (2097152) matches exactly the 8 Taldaram's Torment ranks. BasePoints are 14 (real 15%) on rank 1 and 29 (real 30%) on rank 2, matching the tooltip exactly. Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone/Unit::ApplySpellMod (Unit.cpp) consumes SPELLMOD_DAMAGE and SPELLMOD_DOT generically. spell_modifier queries this without casting or owning the target spells. 572795 and 802580 are the Valanar's Vengeance / Taldaram's Torment ranks a level-80 character owns.

steps.label: No damage bonus on Valanar's Vengeance before Blood Banquet
No DoT bonus on Taldaram's Torment before Blood Banquet
Rank 1 adds 15% direct damage to Valanar's Vengeance
Rank 1 adds 15% DoT damage to Taldaram's Torment
Rank 2 adds 30% direct damage to Valanar's Vengeance
Rank 2 adds 30% DoT damage to Taldaram's Torment
